summary.headline: Your voice is the confident expedition guide — codified, with two off-voice patterns to ban.
summary.narrative: Across the corpus the on-voice writing is confident, uses the summit metaphor, speaks as **we** to **you**, and always names a concrete deliverable. Two samples drift: one stacks unsubstantiated superlatives, one dissolves into generic LLM filler. Both are captured as banned patterns.

codex.voice: Confident expert guide. First-person plural (we/our) for SaaScend; second-person (you/your) for the reader. Short declarative sentences; occasional bolded pre-claim.
codex.tone: Motivational but grounded — every metaphor lands on a concrete deliverable. No emoji. B2B professional.
codex.positioning: We guide go-to-market teams to scale revenue by harmonizing systems, data, strategy, and people — with intention.

pillars.name: Build the map before the climb
pillars.line: Strategy and definitions come before automation.

pillars.name: Clean before you automate
pillars.line: You can't automate a mess — fix the pipeline and the glossary first.

pillars.name: Concrete over aspirational
pillars.line: Every promise ties to a deliverable: a lifecycle, a governed glossary, an enablement plan.

codex.visual_notes: Summit/mountain metaphor. Cyan #00ACD4 section headings, navy #031F49 dark sections, sky-blue #1071C3 pill CTAs. Montserrat headings, Open Sans body. No emoji.
examples: On-voice: "RevOps isn't a dashboard you buy — it's the map you build before the climb."
Off-voice (banned): "Leveraging synergies to unlock holistic, end-to-end growth in today's fast-paced landscape."

drafts.title: SaaScend Brand Codex v1
drafts.content:
VOICE: Confident expert guide. We → you. Short declaratives.
TONE: Motivational but grounded; metaphor always lands on a deliverable. No emoji.
POSITIONING: Harmonize systems, data, strategy, and people to scale revenue — with intention.
PILLARS: (1) Build the map before the climb (2) Clean before you automate (3) Concrete over aspirational.
APPROVED: harmonize · summit/climb · with intention · governed glossary · funnel velocity.
BANNED: best-in-class (unproven) · industry-leading · #1 · guaranteed · leverage synergies · in today's fast-paced landscape · holistic end-to-end · robust/scalable as filler.
VISUAL: Summit metaphor; cyan headings, navy dark sections, sky-blue pill CTAs; Montserrat + Open Sans; no emoji.
